patch.summary: Carla Gericke's video and cable-access series exploring New Hampshire politics, liberty, government transparency and independent thinking.
patch.description: The Independents is a recurring show hosted by Carla Gericke on her YouTube channel, The Art of Independence. The series discusses New Hampshire politics, civil liberties, government transparency and personal independence from a liberty-oriented perspective. Its YouTube playlist brings the episodes together; the creator describes the program as a weekly cable-access show aimed at New Hampshire's undeclared voters. Her website also maintains a dedicated episode archive with written introductions and embedded videos. This entry represents the series, not an individual episode or a separate membership group.
patch.accessInstructions: Open the YouTube series playlist to browse episodes. Carla Gericke's website also has a The Independents archive. Viewing happens on the creator's website or YouTube; Porcupine Directory does not require an account or load an embedded player here.
